name: Breviceratops
sum: Breviceratops is a small protoceratopsid from the Campanian Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia, based on a juvenile skeleton with skull.
wsnote: No size given in the sources used.
holotype: ZPAL MgD-I/117, a partial juvenile postcranial skeleton with skull — Khulsan locality, Barun Goyot Formation, Mongolia.
material: Other specimens from Hermiin Tsav and Khulsan, such as MgD-I/116.
biology: Skull ended in a moderately pronounced neck frill.
author: Kurzanov 1990

sources.text: Kurzanov, S. M. 1990. Новый род протоцератопсид из позднего мела Монголии. Paleontological Journal: 91−97.
